name: Divine Light
source:
Awakening to a world unfamiliar to her, Uri finds herself living with Cas, an angel who hit her with her car. She's entranced, fixated on her halo, her heavenly glow. Uri asks to stay with her, not knowing what it is she's signing up for.

Cas just hit a girl with her car. Whoops. She can't take her to the hospital, and the girl seems to want to live with her. Why not give her a chance? After all, humans are the reason she's here in the first place.

[From [url=https://paletteheart.itch.io/divine-light]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
尤里 (Uri) 在一个陌生的世界中醒来，发现自己与卡斯 (Cas) 住在一起，卡斯是一位用汽车撞了她的天使。她着迷，着迷于她的光环，她天堂般的光芒。尤里要求留下来陪她，但不知道她要报名的是什么。

Cas刚刚用她的车撞到了一个女孩。哎呀。她不能带她去医院，而女孩似乎想和她住在一起。为什么不给她机会呢？毕竟，人类才是她来到这里的首要原因。

[来自[url=https://paletteheart.itch.io/divine-light]itch.io[/url]]
